title: What If the Sea Rose Three Feet by 2100?

scenes.text: What if the sea rose three feet by 2100? The scariest number isn't the water.
NOAA's range for 2100 runs from zero to six feet. Three feet sits right in the middle.
A study of US coastal counties found land housing 4.2 million people at risk of flooding.
Double the rise to six feet, and that number jumps to 13.1 million people.
Nearly half of them live in one state, Florida, and the Southeast holds about seventy percent.
Three feet sounds small. But every tide would start from that higher line, so the coast itself moves.
